steps.action: Run learn web --crawl against the local fixture root URL with two injected child failures
steps.expected: The crawl continues, indexes the root page, and records structured failures for both bad pages
steps.observed: Exit code 0; documentsIndexed=1; failedPages=2; pageFailures contained two fetch_error entries with attempts=3

assertions.title: single-page learn is atomic on failure

steps.action: Run single-page learn against an always-failing URL
steps.expected: The command exits non-zero and does not persist partial documents/chunks/vectors
steps.observed: Exit code 1 with learn web failure text; db scope reported documents=0, chunks=0, manifests=0

steps.action: Inspect the isolated SQLite database directly
steps.expected: No persisted rows remain for documents, chunks, chunk_vec, or source_manifests

assertions.title: Crawl4AI external process has wall-clock timeouts + cleanup

steps.action: Run crawl with a slow child URL and a 1s timeout budget
steps.expected: The child page is marked as a timeout failure and the command completes successfully for the root page

steps.action: Check the reported crawl temp directory after the command exits
steps.expected: The run-scoped crawl temp dir has been removed

assertions.title: Crawl4AI retries are observable and expose attempts

steps.action: Run single-page learn with retry env vars and explicit --fetch-mode get
steps.expected: The command succeeds after retries and exposes the total attempts in JSON

steps.action: Learn the same page twice with different fragment identifiers
steps.expected: Both runs target the same source identity and only one manifest remains in the project DB
steps.observed: Both runs succeeded and db scope reported sourceManifests=1 with a fragment-free sourceKey

assertions.title: Secret query params do not affect source identity

steps.action: Learn the same page twice with different token query values
steps.expected: Both URLs resolve to one source manifest and raw secret values do not persist
steps.observed: db scope reported one manifest with redacted locators; SQLite inspection reported rawAlpha=false and rawBeta=false

frictions.description: The repo defaults to live provider config, so I used a local OpenAI-compatible embedding/LLM stub server in the isolated workspace to keep the validation offline and deterministic.
frictions.resolution: Created a temporary local config pointing embeddings/LLM at http://127.0.0.1:19123/v1 and served deterministic embeddings from the isolated fixture server.

frictions.description: The fake crwl fixture only emits one child link by default, so VAL-LEARN-WEB-001 needed an injected second child link to reach the required two-page failure shape.
frictions.resolution: Used CRWL_CHILD_PATH injection to produce two failing child URLs while still exercising the real CLI crawl flow.
